subject: Admin ledger: on‑demand snapshots and retention reconciliation
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novahealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Request: admin ledger snapshot & retention details for SOC2 review

Hi Irene,

We're getting ready for our SOC 2 readiness check and the reviewer asked for a concise description of what Redwood logs for admin/operator activity, how long those records are retained, and what export options you offer for evidence delivery. Specifically they asked:

- A short list of event categories (console logins, ACL changes, role grants, key rotation, audit exports, session/token usage, service account actions, etc.)
- The default retention and the enterprise options (SLA for extended retention)
- On‑demand vs scheduled exports: formats, delivery targets (S3, signed manifest, streaming), expected turnaround times
- Any redaction/sampling options for PII or cross-tenant noise

If possible, could you send a short example manifest and a recommended export workflow we can share with the auditor? We may want the export delivered to our S3 (us-east-1) with a signed manifest and SHA‑256 checksums.

Thanks — goal is to close this item by end of next week.

Samira
Samira Khan
Security Program Manager, NovaHealth
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-12T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin ledger snapshot & retention details for SOC2 review

Samira — thanks for the clear list. Putting answers below and attaching a short reference pack (PDF) plus a signed-manifest example. TL;DR: we log a comprehensive admin/operator ledger, default retention is 90 days for hosted plans, enterprise customers can purchase 1y or custom retention with SLA; exports can be on‑demand (immediate, rate-limited) or scheduled (daily/weekly) to S3 with HMAC-signed manifests, or via secure streaming to a customer Kafka/HTTPS endpoint.

What we log (high-level categories):
- Authentication events: console & API logins, MFA failures/successes, session start/stop, token issuance and revocation (includes token id and lifetime)
- Authorization changes: role grants/revokes, ACL updates, policy changes, group membership edits
- Privileged operations: key rotations, KMS/HSM operations (metadata only), secret store access attempts (who/which principal)
- Resource-level admin actions: model deployments, rollout changes, instance drain/eviction, autoscale config updates, cache clears
- Operator/agent activity: operator-initiated commands executed via operator tooling, remote session access logs, escalation approvals
- Export & evidence actions: who created/approved an export, export manifest generation, checksum/HMAC signing, delivery target and confirmation events
- System context captured per event: timestamp (UTC), request id, principal id (user/service), source IP, region, user agent, request path, before/after state for config edits (JSON diff up to 16KB)

Retention & options:
- Default hosted retention: 90 days (rolling).
- Enterprise plans: options for 1 year, 3 years, or custom retention; pricing & SLA negotiated in contract.
- Short‑term legal/forensic hold: we support time‑boxed holds scoped to tenant IDs and exportable snapshots.
- Snapshots are immutable, signed, and attest to the set of events included (manifest contains SHA‑256 per object plus an overall HMAC).

Export formats & delivery:
- Format: newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) per event. We also provide a compact CSV summary for high-level audits.
- Manifests: a manifest (.manifest.txt) that lists objects, file sizes, SHA‑256 hashes, export request id, created_by, and an HMAC signature using a customer-provided verification key (or Redwood-managed key for temporary handoffs). Example attached.
- Targets:
  - S3 (preferred): PutObject to a pre-signed, customer-provided bucket in your account. We support server-side encryption (SSE-S3) or SSE-KMS with your CMK.
  - Secure FTP/SFTP (legacy partners)
  - Streaming: TLS-encrypted Kafka or HTTPS webhook with replay window and offset markers (for continuous evidence streaming).
  - Console download: single-file ZIP for small snapshots (immediate).
- Turnaround: On‑demand snapshot via Console/API is typically available within minutes (subject to rate limits). Large historical full exports (multi‑TB) are scheduled; expected completion depends on scope — typical SLA is 48–72 hours for full exports under enterprise agreement.

Redaction & sampling:
- PII redaction: we can apply configurable redaction rules before export (field-level); redaction is done deterministically and recorded in the manifest.
- Tenant-scoped filtering: exports are scoped to tenant_id; cross-tenant noise is excluded.
- Sampling: for very high-volume events, we support deterministic sampling options and provide a sampling manifest describing the sampling ratio and seed.

Integrity & chain-of-custody:
- Exports include: signed manifest, per-file SHA‑256, manifest HMAC, and optional signed timestamp from our KMS.
- We provide a checksums verification script (attached as example) customers can run upon receipt.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm delivery target (S3 vs streaming) and whether you want us to use a Redwood-managed short-lived signing key or your verification key.
2) If S3: share the bucket name and whether SSE-KMS with a customer CMK is required.
3) Decide on retention length for this evidence set (we can do a 1yr hold for the SOC2 window if you want).

Attaching: admin_activity_export_options_v1.pdf, signed-manifest-example.txt, s3-handshake-instructions.docx

If helpful I can set up a 30min call with Ben (export SLA/ops) and Kimberly (redaction & retention).

— Irene Choi
Senior Security Solutions 
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novahealth.com>, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-13T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin ledger snapshot & retention details for SOC2 review

Thanks Irene — adding a couple implementation notes for Samira:

- If you want S3 delivery, the recommended workflow is:
  1) NovaHealth provides a pre-signed PUT endpoint (or an IAM role we assume for PutObject).
  2) We stage the export into a Redwood secured bucket, atomically copy to your bucket, then wipe staging within 24h.
  3) Manifest HMAC is generated with your provided verification key (or Redwood key if you prefer short-lived key approach).

- For large historical exports we do chunking (1GB–10GB files) and parallel upload. We include an export manifest per chunk and an overall export manifest.

- Turnaround & scheduling: On‑demand <10GB returns typically within 10–30 minutes. Exports >500GB are scheduled and estimated based on snapshot size; we'll provide ETA within 4 biz hours after request.

- Proof-of-delivery: we publish an S3 event and an attestation entry in our audit ledger showing export completed + checksum match. That attestation entry is itself included in the export (so you have the provenance chain).

Samira — if you confirm bucket name and whether you want KMS/CMEK, we can stage a test export (1–2GB) this week.

Ben Carter
Technical Program Manager, Security Integrations
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novahealth.com>

Thanks — this is exactly what the auditor asked for. Quick answers:
- We want the export to our S3 (bucket: novahealth-audit-us-east-1) with SSE-KMS using our CMK (we will share ARN via secure channel).
- Please use our verification key for HMAC on the manifest.
- We'd like a 1-year retention for the SOC2 window; please go ahead and put a time‑boxed hold for the tenant id NOVA-2142.

Can we schedule the test export for Friday? If you can provide the pre-signed role/PUT instructions today I will forward them to our infra team.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samira
